Probability that a pixel in a cell is clear

cl_clear_prob.Rd

Converts the cloud fraction of each observation into a clear probability.

"independent" sets the probability that a pixel at a random location in the cell is clear to 1 - cloud_fraction. With tier "metadata" the fraction is that of the whole scene, so the value assumes that the cell is as cloudy as the scene; scene metadata carry no information on where in the footprint the cloud was.

"empirical" requires tier "qa" or "mask" data, where the fraction was measured for the cell rather than inferred from the scene, and also returns 1 - cloud_fraction.

"clustered" answers a different question: the probability that the cell observation is usable at threshold, that is, that at least 1 - threshold of the cell is observed and clear, when the clear share of the cell follows a Beta distribution with mean 1 - cloud_fraction and concentration kappa. Small kappa makes cells mostly clear or mostly cloudy. The model is intended for scene-level fractions, where the share of a particular cell is unknown.

Usage

cl_clear_prob(obs, model = c("independent", "clustered", "empirical"), kappa
  = 0.5, coverage = TRUE, threshold = 0.2)

Arguments

obs

A cl_obs table.

model

One of "independent", "clustered", "empirical".

kappa

Beta concentration for "clustered".

coverage

Take the valid share of the cell (column valid_fraction, present in tier "qa") into account, so that the probability refers to a pixel at a random location in the cell rather than to a pixel within the observed part. Has no effect on tables without that column.

threshold

Usability threshold for "clustered", see cl_clear_obs.

Value

Numeric vector of probabilities, one per row of obs.
